summary: Ingram Micro Holding Corp filed an 8-K on July 30, 2026, reporting Q2 results and a declared quarterly dividend. The filing also disclosed that Platinum Equity completed a block trade of 5,167,069 shares at $29.03 per share on June 15, 2026, reducing its stake to 76.9%. The company received no proceeds. No tender offer, strategic review, or other special situation is present. The dividend of $0.086 per share is routine. The block trade is an ordinary secondary-market sale by a controlling shareholder without a defined transaction.
